description: This file contains the implementation of the QR decomposition class within a matrix library, providing methods for matrix decomposition, reconstruction, and solving linear systems.

classes.name: QR
classes.description: Performs QR decomposition of a matrix using Householder reflections, providing methods to retrieve Q, R, and related properties, as well as solving linear systems.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the QR decomposition with the provided matrix and performs the decomposition.

methods.name: getHouseholdVectors
methods.description: Returns the Householder vectors as a Matrix.

methods.name: getQ
methods.description: Constructs and returns the orthogonal matrix Q from the decomposition.

methods.name: getR
methods.description: Constructs and returns the upper triangular matrix R from the decomposition.

methods.name: hypo
methods.description: Calculates the Euclidean norm (hypotenuse) in a numerically stable way, used in the decomposition process.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Performs the QR decomposition using Householder reflections.

methods.name: isFullRank
methods.description: Checks whether the matrix is of full rank based on the R diagonal elements.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Solves linear systems of the form A*X = B using the QR decomposition.
